metadata.title: Server Monitoring and Response

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability providing visibility, detection, and coordinated response for servers and workloads.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Security monitoring, analytics, and incident response technology domain.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Log aggregation, telemetry pipelines, SIEM, and incident response coordination platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Centralized server telemetry with correlated detection and coordinated incident response.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Server logs, security telemetry, alerts, incident records, and response artifacts.

metadata.remarks:
Server Monitoring and Response defines the capability to observe server and workload behavior, detect indicators of compromise or misuse, and coordinate response actions across the enterprise. This pattern provides centralized visibility and response enablement and is intentionally distinct from runtime enforcement or host-level threat prevention.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to server observability, detection, and response coordination. Controls are scoped to visibility, analysis, and coordination only.

components.title: Telemetry Collection
components.description: Collection and aggregation of logs and security-relevant telemetry from servers and workloads.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of application-layer protocols for command and control traffic from compromised servers.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Centralized collection and retention of security-relevant server telemetry.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Collect server audit records and security telemetry in a centralized manner.

components.title: Detection and Correlation
components.description: Analysis and correlation of server telemetry to detect malicious or abnormal activity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Execution of malicious commands or scripts within server workloads.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Correlation and behavioral analysis to identify abnormal or malicious server activity.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Analyze server activity to identify indicators of compromise or misuse.
Review and analyze server audit logs for security-relevant events.

components.title: Incident Response Coordination
components.description: Coordination of response activities across operational, security, and recovery teams.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or disruption of incident data to delay or evade response.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Coordinated execution and tracking of response actions across teams.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Coordinate server incident response activities using defined procedures.

components.title: Evidence and Forensics
components.description: Preservation and analysis of server data to support investigation and lessons learned.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or manipulation of logs to evade detection or investigation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Preservation and analysis of forensic evidence for accountability and recovery.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Collect, preserve, and analyze evidence related to server incidents.
